keyPoints: Chakravriddhi byaj (compound interest) me har saal byaj mooldhan me jud jaata hai — agle saal byaj badhe hue dhan par lagta hai.
Chakravriddhi byaj = mishradhan - mooldhan; lambe samay me ye saadhe byaj se kaafi zyada hota hai — isliye bank me jama dhan chakravriddhi se badhta hai.
Chhoot (discount) = ankit moolya - vikray moolya; chhoot% = (chhoot ÷ ankit moolya) x 100.
Kramik chhooton me pehli chhoot ke baad bachi rakam par doosri lagti hai — 20% phir 10% matlab kul 28% chhoot, 30% nahi.
Bikri kar vikray moolya par lagta hai — bill me kar judne ke baad kul dey rakam badh jaati hai.
Aam galti: chakravriddhi byaj ko saadhe byaj se guna karke nikalna — har saal ka byaj naye mooldhan par lagta hai, purane par nahi.
subject: Maths
title: Chakravriddhi Byaj aur Chhoot
